name: Wall-Mounted Bluetooth Music Boxing Target with Gloves
description: A wall-mounted boxing target that connects to your phone by Bluetooth, plays your music and lights up in time with the beat. Pick the shape: round with a digital display, round with a star centre, hexagon, round white and grey, or five-point star with a digital display. Each set comes with a pair of gloves, a USB-C cable, a backing pad and three mounting straps. The listed material is PU.

source.notes: HOLD, DO NOT DRAFT: the 1688 page says 'Shipment to Nigeria: Not available for sale in your region'; the owner is checking with the forwarder and will confirm it can ship to Nigeria before this is drafted. Supplier: Dongyang Kesheng Technology Co., Ltd. (14 years on 1688), 4K+ sets sold, 1,500+ praise. Title: 'New Boxing Target Bluetooth Music Wall Target Home Smart Sports Music Boxing Machine Manufacturer Version Boxing Trainer'. Price CNY 5 (about N1,116.66) to CNY 118 (about N26,353.26) per set from 1 set; fx_rate 223.33 = 1116.66 / 5. Which style costs what is not shown (CNY 5 is likely an accessory such as gloves only). Owner chose unit_cost CNY 118 (top of the range) for all styles, one listing (2 Nov 2026). Attributes: other boxing supplies, item no. boxing target1, brand MDHL (the supplier's registered brand; logo on the hero photo; kept out of name, copy, tags and photos), material PU. Packed: width 43 cm, height 5 cm, 13,545 cm3 (length column cut off, implies 63 cm), 2,300 g in all 4 rows; shipping.weight_kg 2.3. Heavy and bulky: freight will weigh heavily on margin. ships_by_air false: a USB-C cable is in the box, so a built-in rechargeable battery is likely (capacity not stated); sea only, confirmed by the owner (2 Nov 2026). The hero photo shows UL, GS, PSE, KC, CE and BSCI marks: no certification claimed. Chinese marketing text, music-app logos and the MDHL banner are cropped out. Features kept to Bluetooth music and lights following the beat; no fitness or calorie claims. 5 styles photographed; kit per photos: gloves (open-finger MMA style in most, classic boxing gloves with the hexagon), USB-C cable, backing pad, 3 straps; no photo of the kit is used (too small to cut cleanly). Photos are 800 px crops except the star-centre cutout (1920 px), so soft. Return rate not shown. 13 of 14 attachments arrived.
